subject: Quick check: Discovery recap & timeline (VeloxAI)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check: Discovery recap & timeline (VeloxAI)

Alex — great meeting earlier. Thanks for taking the time. I wanted to send a short recap while things are fresh and confirm next steps/timeline from your side.

Key takeaways from today’s call:
- Primary use case: real-time inference at <100ms P95 for customer-facing recommendations (10–20 req/s steady; bursts to 200).
- Data footprint: anonymized product events, no PII, stored in our analytics infra; concerns around retention and audit logs noted.
- Success metrics: move to 1% conversion lift on recommendations and reduce inference cost per 1k requests by >=30% vs your current setup.
- Desired pilot: 4–6 week proof-of-value running on dedicated pool with transparent cost/latency dashboards.

Open questions we flagged:
- Procurement timeline and any mandatory clauses (data residency, audit access).
- Internal approval owner for a pilot vs. full rollout.

Suggested next steps (pick one):
1) 15-min sync this week to confirm pilot scope + procurement touchpoints (I’ll invite a solutions engineer).
2) I send a short pilot SOW and a reference pricing band for your procurement team to review.

I’ve attached the discovery notes and a short architecture sketch for the pilot. If this still looks like low-to-medium priority on your roadmap, say so and I’ll set a softer follow-up cadence.

Thanks again — happy to adapt to whatever timing works on your side.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

- Priority: still in Q4 consideration but procurement wants a clear pilot SOW and an expected cost range before we loop in legal.
- Timeline: decision window looks like late Oct / early Nov; internal stakeholder is VP Product (working with procurement).
- Questions: do you have a short template SOW + an example pricing band for a 4-week dedicated pilot? Also need to understand audit log retention and access for SOC-type checks.

If you can send a two-pager (SOW + ballpark numbers) I’ll share with procurement and come back with next steps. Thanks for the nudge.
